outcome: Effectiveness of Ursodeoxycholic acid in treatment of intrahepatic cholestatic of pregnancy
cohort: 60 women in their 2nd and 3rd trimesters diagnosed with Intrahepatic Cholestasis of Pregnancy (ICP) at a tertiary hospital.
finding: Treatment with Ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA) resulted in a significant reduction in clinical symptoms and good perinatal outcomes.
